purpose: Constraints and deferred effects for developing the session simulator

rules.name: Keep multiple contexts within one owner
rules.quote: If I have errands after work, I sometimes use a charger near the office.
rules.implementation: Sample an owner profile with all its context records. Allocate each session to one context; do not treat each context row as a different owner.
rules.boundary: Interview context mentions are not allocation weights. Survey total and context frequencies still need reconciliation.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: On workdays I usually come home and connect the car. I check what I need to do the next morning, then decide whether to schedule the charging for later. If I have errands after work, I sometimes use a charger near the office.

rules.name: Use the reported charging-start window once
rules.quote: I connect it when I get home, but I set the car to begin charging later.
rules.implementation: Use survey charging-start windows as actual start windows. Do not apply an additional automatic TOU delay to the baseline profile.
rules.boundary: A future tariff-change scenario would require separately stated assumptions; usual reported timing does not measure its causal effect.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: I connect it when I get home, but I set the car to begin charging later. If I must leave early the next morning, I sometimes start immediately because I would rather pay more than risk having too little charge.

rules.name: Separate active charging from connected time
rules.quote: At home the car can remain connected after it finishes, but it stops drawing power at the target.
rules.implementation: Accumulate demand only over active charging intervals. Keep parked or connected duration separate from electrical charging duration.
rules.boundary: A recalled duration is not automatically a measured active duration. Any simplified power curve must be declared separately.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: At home the car can remain connected after it finishes, but it stops drawing power at the target. At a public station I watch the app and return around completion because someone else may need the charger.

rules.name: Respect reported home-charging access
rules.quote: I cannot charge at home. I park in a shared apartment area and there is no approved charging point there.
rules.implementation: If survey home access is 'No, I cannot charge at home', do not create T2 sessions. Flag contradictory home-use answers for review instead of silently rewriting them.
rules.boundary: Limited access is not the same as no access. The interview case cannot be linked to a survey owner by its number.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: I cannot charge at home. I park in a shared apartment area and there is no approved charging point there.

rules.name: Keep energy accounting consistent across sessions
rules.quote: I charged less at home the following night.
rules.implementation: Account for energy across an owner's sessions. A context switch must not automatically add a second full daily energy requirement; extra travel can increase energy only through an explicit assumption or observation.
rules.boundary: The passage supports possible substitution, not a fixed amount or universal replacement rule. Do not add distance-derived energy to delivered energy for the same requirement.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: Last month a relative needed a lift that evening. I used a public charger near the hospital because the planned overnight home charge would have been too late. I charged less at home the following night.

rules.name: Keep temporary disruption separate from usual behaviour
rules.quote: A temporary equipment problem can make a normally home-dominant owner appear public-dominant in a short observation window.
rules.implementation: Retain an exceptional-period annotation when reviewing evidence. Do not overwrite usual survey behaviour solely because a short public-charging history differs.
rules.boundary: Do not infer an equipment failure from a mismatch alone, or automatically discard records. An exceptional-period flag requires supporting evidence.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: A temporary equipment problem can make a normally home-dominant owner appear public-dominant in a short observation window.

rules.name: Trip urgency may change charging decisions
rules.quote: If I do not know whether there will be an extra trip tomorrow, I charge earlier and aim a little higher.
rules.implementation: Keep this as a contextual dependency. Do not introduce random urgent-trip events or a fixed target increase in the baseline yet.
rules.boundary: An event rate and adjustment magnitude need observations or explicitly labelled sensitivity assumptions; 'a little higher' provides neither.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: If I do not know whether there will be an extra trip tomorrow, I charge earlier and aim a little higher. That is different from a normal office night when I know the distance.

rules.name: Unavailable chargers may change the next action
rules.quote: If I can get home comfortably, I leave; otherwise I check a second station or wait a short time.
rules.implementation: Retain the conditional options for later analysis. Do not invent queue durations, station failures, or switch probabilities in the baseline.
rules.boundary: Executing a queue or station-availability model would require further evidence or an explicitly separate sensitivity scenario.
rules.review_method: AI-assisted contextual reading for synthetic design; exact quotation verified by script
rules.full_answer: First I look at the battery and the time. If I can get home comfortably, I leave; otherwise I check a second station or wait a short time. I do not assume the next station is free.

review_scope: Selected passages only; the remaining interview answers are not coded or approved by this step.
constraints: No survey owner is linked to an interview case by its number.
No event rates, power ratings or energy adjustments are inferred from qualitative words.
Survey field names are mapping references, not evidence of calibrated parameters.
These scripted interviews provide no empirical prevalence or national estimates.
